source_metadata.batching: not required; 2-page case report processed as one semantic unit

consistency_findings: The daptomycin MIC progression is represented once as a single serial-isolate result family; treatment-response observations are retained as distinct assertions at different treatment phases.

extraction_limitations: This is a single-patient case report without a comparator group or causal design.
The source has no standalone methods section; microbiology methods are primarily stated in the Figure 1 legend and discussion.
The report does not specify the full laboratory method for candidate-gene comparison beyond reporting the comparison result.
General background claims in the Introduction and literature-summary claims in the Discussion were not atomized as primary-study results.
schema_gaps: The current QuantitativeResult model has no explicit representation for censored/inequality values such as rifampin MIC >32 mg/L; that assertion is preserved as a qualitative_result with the numeric threshold in the canonical statement and source excerpt.
The schema has no dedicated longitudinal treatment-sequence object, so regimen changes and microbiologic responses are represented as separate independently reviewable atoms.
